meSpeak 2.0.2 (Modular eSpeak) by Norbert Landsteiner, based on speak.js by
Alon Zakai and eSpeak by Jonathan Duddington. Licensed under the GNU General
Public License (GPL v3). Bundled here unmodified into one browser file
(mespeak.min.js) with its config and the en-rp voice.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mespeak (https://github.com/mikolalysenko/mespeak),
http://www.masswerk.at/mespeak/, https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng

Used by the Shop TV's Conquest newsreel when the TV's browser has no voice of
its own (src/lib/filmSound.ts loads it only then).
